name: yellowparrot-abdm-devkit
description: Unofficial ABDM developer toolkit, mock environment only: request consent, fetch encrypted records and check FHIR documents with synthetic data. Not affiliated with NHA.
long_description: Runs a simulated ABDM gateway and HIP inside the extension. Every consent request and record fetch asks you to confirm it first. All data is synthetic; nothing is sent to ABDM or any other service. Sandbox and production use are not supported in this build.

tools.name: abdm_demo_scenarios
tools.description: List how the simulated patient can respond

tools.name: abdm_consent_request
tools.description: Request patient consent after you confirm it

tools.name: abdm_health_info_request
tools.description: Fetch records under a granted consent after you confirm it

tools.name: abdm_health_info_result
tools.description: Read records received for a fetch

tools.name: abdm_workflow_status
tools.description: List your consent requests and fetches

tools.name: abdm_fhir_generate
tools.description: Build an ABDM FHIR document bundle

tools.name: abdm_fhir_validate
tools.description: Check an ABDM FHIR document bundle
